summary: Rotation regime with bank earnings catalyzing financials higher while crypto and biotech lag. Powell criminal investigation creating haven flows into gold/silver/BTC but adding macro uncertainty. CPI data (due Feb 13 for Jan) not yet released; market digesting strong bank results vs political risk to Fed independence.

sections.title: Macro
sections.content: DOJ criminal investigation of Fed Chair Powell announced Jan 11 is the dominant macro theme, creating uncertainty around Fed independence and rate policy. Bitcoin rallied past $97K as haven asset. Silver continuing its 2025 rally (144% in 2025) with industrial demand at record 1.12B oz. S&P 500 pulled back ~0.5% on Jan 14 after a strong start to the year. Sector rotation underway: materials +9%, energy strong, financials mixed but banks beating on earnings. Small caps outpacing large caps in early 2026.

sections.title: Corporate
sections.content: Goldman Sachs Q4 2025: profit $4.62B ($14.01/share, +12% YoY), IB fees surged 25% to $2.58B. Revenue dipped 3% to $13.45B due to Apple Card portfolio offload. Morgan Stanley Q4: net income +18% to $4.4B, dealmaking revenue +47%. Both report pre-market Jan 15. TSMC Q4 results strong with 62.3% gross margin, guided Q1 2026 revenue $34.6-35.8B. LLY down ~3.8% on FDA delay of Orforglipron oral weight-loss pill. Intel rallying on Panther Lake/18A process but Q4 earnings Jan 22 may disappoint on guidance. Moderna at JPM conference guided 2025 rev ~$1.9B, targeting 10% growth in 2026.

sections.title: Technicals
sections.content: S&P 500 at ~5930-5960 range, pulling back from record highs. GS approaching all-time high near $970 pre-earnings. MS at all-time high territory near $181-185. Silver (SLV) in strong uptrend, $83 level. Bitcoin breaking above $97K, testing 2-month highs. INTC extended after 84% 2025 rally and 15%+ YTD gain - may be stretched. Crypto names (COIN, MARA) pulling back despite BTC strength, divergence suggesting sector-specific headwinds.

scenarios.trade: Goldman's Q4 results are strong across capital markets businesses. IB fees of $2.58B signal a robust deal environment. In a rotation regime, financials catching a bid from earnings beats fits the sector rotation theme. GS closed near $924 on Jan 14 and the stock rallied 4.6% on earnings day to close near $970. Entry at prior close captures the earnings pop.

scenarios.implication: Revenue dipped 3% due to Apple Card portfolio offload - headline revenue miss could spook algos initially. Broader market weakness from Powell investigation could cap upside. Stock already near ATH, limiting room for further expansion.

scenarios.trade: Morgan Stanley's 47% jump in dealmaking revenue is the standout figure among bank earnings. The wealth management franchise provides earnings stability while IB upside delivers the catalyst. MS gained 6% on earnings day, outperforming GS. In rotation regime, strong bank earnings drive sector rebalancing into financials.

scenarios.implication: Stock at all-time highs with limited technical support at these levels. If broader market sells off on Powell investigation escalation, banks could reverse despite strong earnings. Wealth management growth may slow if market volatility increases.

scenarios.trade: Silver is in a secular uptrend (144% in 2025) with both safe-haven and industrial demand tailwinds. The Powell investigation is driving haven flows into precious metals alongside crypto. In a rotation regime with slightly bearish directional bias, precious metals offer a non-correlated trade. SLV rose 3.2% on Jan 15, confirming momentum. Supply constraints from China export restrictions add structural support.

scenarios.implication: Silver extremely extended after 144% 2025 rally - vulnerable to sharp corrections (late Jan saw 17% crash on Warsh Fed chair nomination). Leveraged longs could unwind rapidly. If Powell investigation is resolved quickly, haven premium evaporates.

scenarios.trade: COIN is selling off despite Bitcoin rallying past $97K - a clear negative divergence. This suggests institutional rotation out of crypto equities even as spot crypto benefits from haven flows. In a rotation regime, this divergence trade captures the dislocation. MARA also fell 4.1% on the same day, confirming the crypto equity weakness is broad-based. MARA selling 15K BTC for AI pivot signals miners losing conviction in pure crypto plays.

scenarios.implication: If Bitcoin breaks $100K, COIN could snap back violently as retail piles in. Crypto equities can move 10%+ in a day on sentiment shifts. Coinbase's institutional business and ETF custody fees provide fundamental support that may reassert.

scenarios.trade: LLY dropped ~3.8% on an FDA administrative delay for the oral GLP-1 Orforglipron - not a clinical failure or safety issue. In a rotation regime, mean reversion on high-quality names after overreactions is a core strategy. The obesity treatment market is massive and LLY's pipeline (tirzepatide franchise + oral next-gen) is unmatched. This is a buy-the-dip setup on regulatory noise, not fundamental deterioration.

scenarios.implication: If the FDA delay signals deeper regulatory scrutiny of GLP-1 class, the selloff could extend. Broader pharma/biotech weakness (MRNA also down 3%) may indicate sector rotation OUT of healthcare. LLY trading at elevated multiples leaves limited margin of safety.

Financial sector ETF. If GS/MS earnings kick off broader bank rally, XLF could break out. But financial services sector has been 2nd-worst performer YTD - needs confirmation.
